finding.summary: When seq_len % 32 == 0 and hidden_dim % 32 == 0: The block shape of the sparse attention pattern is hard-coded to 32x64 ("currently only support 32 x 64") and ignores any block size the caller might want; the only caller-influenced check is divisibility by 32, so a mask whose natural block granularity is different is silently re-blocked at 32x64, changing which blocks are considered non-zero.
